name: Dr. Armin Hoell-Steier
headline: Monetizing Digital Platforms for Financial Services & PE Portfolios | Strategy to Go-Live | Partner @ DevelopX | Ex-CEO CHECK24 | Ex-BCG & Bain
summary:
Als ich CHECK24 Sachversicherung geführt habe, habe ich eine Sache gelernt, die kein Strategieberater ausspricht: Die brillanteste Plattform-Strategie ist exakt null wert, wenn die Umsetzung nicht steht.
  
Genau deshalb bin ich heute Partner bei DevelopX. Weil ich beide Seiten kenne – die Boardroom-Präsentation und den Go-Live um 3 Uhr nachts.
  
Was ich mitbringe:
✅ 13+ Jahre Top-Strategie- & Wachstumsberatung (BCG, Bain)
✅ 5+ Jahre operative Geschäftsführung (CHECK24 – größtes deutsches Versicherungs-Ökosystem mit aufgebaut)
✅ 20+ erfolgreiche Transformationsprojekte
  
Spezialisierung:
→ GenAI-Integration & Voice-AI-Systeme
→ Multi-Channel-Distribution & Ökosysteme
→ Digitale Produktentwicklung & Customer Journeys
→ Company Building & Portfolio-Management
  
Wenn Sie wissen wollen, wie Ihr Plattform-Projekt nicht nur auf einer Folie, sondern im Markt funktioniert – schreiben Sie mir.

What DevelopX does:
We are the digitalization and consulting unit of TruVenturo, one of Europe's most successful company builders with 25+ tech startups and over €800 million in exit value (including IPOs of HomeToGo, Finanzcheck, and others).

With 350+ entrepreneurs, digitalization and product experts, and agile software developers at 6 European locations, we build digital champions – from strategy to go-live.

My responsibilities:
🎯 Lead Financial Services & Insurance
Responsible for all insurance and banking projects. Development of digital business models, multi-channel distribution, embedded insurance, and GenAI integration for leading insurers in the DACH region.

📈 Marketing, Sales & Business Development
Building DevelopX into a leading digital consultancy for financial services. Responsible for overall go-to-market strategy, brand building, and strategic partnerships.

👥 Recruiting & Talent Acquisition
Building and scaling the partner network and recruiting pipeline for top talent from consulting, tech, and insurance.

Our work:
- Digital transformation: From legacy systems to modern, scalable platforms
- AI & automation: Voice AI, GenAI integration, process automation along the value chain
- Embedded insurance: Point-of-need coverage, employee benefits, broker enablement
- Transaction Advisory: M&A support, digital due diligence, post-merger integration

Successes:
✅ Supported 20+ digital transformation projects in the insurance and finance industry
✅ Built several new digital business areas from concept to market entry
✅ Established DevelopX as a thought leader for insurance innovation in the DACH region
